mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and related goods, which in turn drives economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases borrowing costs and reduces consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a growing supply of goods and services, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, indicates a growing demand for goods and services, which leads to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate and a decrease in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicate a tightening monetary cycle and reduced inflationary pressures, which lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of high federal funds rates and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, indicate a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment rates and high payroll employment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP and a decrease in the unemployment rate, as measured by GDPC1 and UNRATE, indicate a growing economy and a strong labor market, which lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low unemployment rates (t-test p > 0.05).
